title: InsideEVs: All the non-Tesla EVs that can use Tesla Superchargers in 2026
notes: US list: Chevrolet Bolt EV/EUV, Cadillac Optiq/Lyriq/Celestiq/Vistiq, GMC Hummer EV, GMC Sierra EV, Honda Prologue, Acura ZDX listed as compatible; Chevrolet Spark EV "cannot be recharged at Tesla Superchargers". Clarity Electric and Fit EV not mentioned.
